item.title: [Motion & 3D] Tactile UI & Physics-Driven Motion
item.description: Developers and tech creators are actively moving away from flat UIs. This pattern leverages depth, haptics, and physics-based motion to create interfaces that feel more responsive and 'real' to the user, significantly boosting engagement and perceived quality. | Fonts: Inter (Display) + IBM Plex Sans (Body/Mono) | Palette: #1A1A1A #FF6B6B #FFD93D #6BCB77 | Prompt: Design a responsive, interactive component for a financial dashboard. It must feature tactile feedback, subtle skeuomorphic depth, and physics-driven motion for state changes. Focus on a button that 'depresses' with a slight bounce and an input field with a soft, glowing focus state, implying physical interaction. Use a neutral background.

item.title: [UI & Layout] Anti-Generic AI Layout Directives
item.description: AI agents frequently default to predictable UI patterns (centered headline, purple gradient, three cards) leading to visual monotony and diluted brand identity. This system leverages explicit negative constraints and unique compositional principles to guide AI toward fresh, non-standard layouts that capture attention. | Fonts: Outfit + Inter | Palette: #3A0CA3 #F72585 #4CC9F0 #4361EE | Prompt: Develop a landing page layout. Absolutely no centered headlines, soft purple gradients, or three-column icon cards. Prioritize asymmetrical balance, a strong vertical rhythm, and a primary call-to-action positioned in the top-right quadrant, contrasting sharply with a secondary element in the bottom-left. Utilize a split-screen approach with distinct typography for each half, emphasizing visual tension and dynamic flow.

item.title: [UI & Layout] Newspaper Grid UI: Retro-Functional Type
item.description: The market rejects generic "dark gradient cards." Users seek unique, content-first UIs that act as clear contracts. This pattern leverages structured grids and distinct retro typography to create a memorable, functional user experience, moving beyond superficial aesthetics. | Fonts: Press Start 2P + IBM Plex Mono | Palette: #2A2F36 #F0F0F0 #D62828 #7A828C | Prompt: Design a responsive web portfolio inspired by a vintage newspaper layout. Utilize a strict grid system for content blocks, emphasizing clear sectioning. Implement 'Press Start 2P' for all headings and 'IBM Plex Mono' for body text and code snippets. Ensure the color palette is limited to `#2A2F36`, `#F0F0F0`, `#D62828`, and `#7A828C`. Focus on readability and information hierarchy over visual fluff, making each UI element a clear user contract.
